$comment: Machine-readable authoring grammar for DA/AEM verb pages, consumed alongside verb-content.schema.json. `variants` is the KNOWN enum surface, not enforced — unknown variants pass through into the raw blocks[] catch-all. Comparison is case- and hyphen/space-insensitive. Kept in sync with src/extractors.js (BLOCK_GRAMMAR, SECTION_METADATA) by a test.

blockTypes.name: How To
blockTypes.notes: Row 0 = heading + intro + optional video line; row 1 = "-" bulleted steps.

blockTypes.name: Accordion
blockTypes.notes: Only the UN-varianted Accordion becomes `faq` (alternating Q/A rows). Variants like "verb subfooter mobile" (related-tools mobile nav) and "seo" are ignored by the faq extractor.

blockTypes.name: Rnr
blockTypes.notes: The `Verb` row declares the verb id; used to cross-check the filename, not emitted as a component.

blockTypes.name: Section Metadata
blockTypes.notes: Per-section styling; see `sectionMetadata` enums for `style` / `background` values.

blockTypes.name: Text
blockTypes.notes: Marketing copy / section headings. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Icon Block
blockTypes.notes: SEO feature card: icon + heading + body. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Media
blockTypes.notes: Image + copy + CTA links. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Columns
blockTypes.notes: Related-tools footer grid. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Breadcrumbs
blockTypes.notes: Breadcrumb navigation. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Editorial Card
blockTypes.notes: Editorial/promo card. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Metadata
blockTypes.notes: Page-level metadata (title, description, etc.). Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Unity
blockTypes.notes: Loads the Unity SDK and wires the verb → DC Hosted bridge. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.

blockTypes.name: Verb Widget
blockTypes.notes: Newer lightweight verb widget; the variant selects the verb/workflow. Present in raw `blocks[]` only.
